scientific_integrity: Unproved generalizations excluded; symbolic polynomial and finite checks are distinguished from proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the four-point diamond; no general rank theorem for height-three posets or all outer derivations. Exhaustive computer checks only for F2 and F3; universal proof is by field-independent row elimination. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: The adjoint-rank polynomial of the four-element diamond incidence algebra
